title: Milk Thistle for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Milk Thistle for Hair Growth: Studies, Silymarin & Safety | FullyVital
seo_description: What a clinical study of milk thistle flower extract shampoo and lab research on silibinin show for hair, and what is known about silymarin safety.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (1,970 words, 0 study links) made unsourced hair claims. Removed; rewritten around the 2024 clinical study, the silibinin lab study and the silymarin safety review.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
The hair study tested a flower-extract shampoo, not silymarin capsules; the article says so.
The You 2024 abstract does not give sample size or study design details beyond 'clinical study' vs 'placebo'.
'Silymarin is the major constituent of its extract and what most supplements contain' – first half is from the Soleimani abstract, the second half is general.
